header: IN THE HIGH COURT OF SINDH
DATE ORDER WITH SIGNATURE OF JUDGE
None present for the appellant; nor intimation received. Same
body: was the position on last two consecutive dates of hearing. Perusal of record reveals that instant Acquittal Appeal was filed against the judgment dated 30-05-2017 passed in Direct Complaint No. 02 of 2016, whereas as per section 417(2 & 3) Cr.P.C a Special Leave to Appeal to maintain the Acquittal Appeal is required to be filed within 60 days; however, no such Special Leave to Appeal has been preferred, therefore, instant Acquittal Appeal is not maintainable; hence same is hereby dismissed alongwith listed pending application.
